name: 必应搜索
description: 在必应搜索一个关键词，取回前10条结果（标题+链接+正文摘要）。

body.name: js

args.expression: (async()=>{const deadline=Date.now()+15000;while(Date.now()<deadline&&document.readyState!=="complete")await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200));const sels=["#sb_form_q","input[name=q]","input[type=search]"];const start=Date.now();while(Date.now()-start<10000){let el=null;for(const s of sels){const c=document.querySelector(s);if(c&&c.offsetParent!==null){el=c;break;}}if(!el){const all=document.querySelectorAll("input[type=text],input[type=search],textarea,[contenteditable=true]");for(const c of all){if(c.offsetParent!==null){el=c;break;}}}if(el){el.focus();el.setAttribute("data-bp-focus","1");return true;}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400));}return false;})()

body.note: 等待页面就绪后聚焦搜索框

outputs.name: links
outputs.description: 搜索结果列表，每项含title和url
